hook: Daniel Gross co-leads compute at Meta, a role his LinkedIn profile dates from June 2025. Before that he co-founded Safe Superintelligence Inc., started Y Combinator's AI program as a partner, and has invested since 2013 in companies including Stripe, ElevenLabs, Perplexity, Rippling and Groq, partly through NFDG with Nat Friedman. His own first company, Cue, was acquired by Apple, where he then worked as a director.
